records.subject: You're in -- let's get Maple Systems set up
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Following up on your Wrenfield setup
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for the note — glad things are going well so far, and good to hear the welcome call was useful.

Since you've got your first project going and a teammate invited, the next step is usually getting real work flowing inside that project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week to look at how you want Maple Systems' work structured.

And if more of the team needs access, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Best,
Priya
